decision_rationale: The record presents a new pretraining framework, CoMTIP, rather than a review or wrapper. It jointly learns from histology images and gene-expression sentences, with explicit image-text alignment in a shared latent space.
evidence_snippet: "Contrastive Masked Text-Image Pretraining"; "receives ... histology images ... together with corresponding collections of gene-expression sentences"; "Image and text representations are aligned in a shared InfoNCE-optimised space"; "The text branch applies a scalable Gene-Text Encoder"
